full_name: Christopher Muller | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 Social Sciences Shutzer Fellow University of California, Berkeley
bio: Christopher Muller is a sociologist who studies the political economy of incarceration in the United States from Reconstruction to the present, with a particular interest in how agricultural labor markets, migration, and struggles over land and labor have affected incarceration and racial and class inequality in incarceration.
